executionHistory.scope: Before migration from native title to themed Tooltip

executionHistory.reason: Strict focus-ring RGBA revealed Chromium GPU translucent color-mix conversion rounds differently on reused Canvas surfaces versus fresh surfaces. Both observed and expected converters now use fresh surfaces; no tolerance introduced.
One instantaneous pointer jump did not emit further pointer moves beyond the Radix hoverable-content grace region; realistic eight-step pointer movement closes the tooltip.
Final project Tooltip keyboard traversal could not reach its trigger after Settings closed.
After actual Settings Close and Dialog DOM removal, focus did not return to the Settings button. This focused assertion remains in the test pending root product repair.

executionHistory.productRepair: Root replaced native title with real themed Tooltip and restored controlled Dialog opener focus through shared DialogContent onOpenAutoFocus/onCloseAutoFocus handlers.

currentStatus: final verification passed after actual Dialog focus-return repair

helperConversionProbe.resolution: Fresh surfaces on both sides with exact channel comparisons

retryNotes: Initial five passed before native title migration. That audit identified the theme limitation and root replaced both actual title hints with the existing Tooltip components.

Strict translucent focus-ring pixel comparison initially failed in the test helper because GPU Canvas surface reuse rounds the same color-mix differently. Both observed and expected paths now use fresh surfaces and exact channel equality; no assertion tolerance was added.
Real Tooltip closure requires a pointer trajectory rather than a single jump into the Radix hoverable-content grace region; eight actual mouse steps exercise leave behavior.

The focus-only rerun revealed a real controlled Dialog opener-focus defect. Root fixed shared DialogContent; the strict close-to-Settings assertion remains and all five final cases pass. All earlier failure traces/screenshots remain in their original directories.
